references.text: The spies reported on the Anakim who lived in the land and described them as a strong people
The spies described the size of the Anakim and said they felt like grasshoppers compared to them
Moses reminds the people how they feared the Anakim and the great fortified cities
The Emim who lived there before were considered giants, like the Anakim
Description of a people who were large, numerous, and tall like the Anakim
Joshua drove out the Anakim from the hill country and their cities
Caleb asked to receive the land of the Anakim and trusted that the Lord would help him drive them out
Caleb drove out the three sons of the Anakim from Hebron
